# Antibiotic Prophylaxis for GI Endoscopic Ultrasound FNA Procedures

The purpose of antibiotic prophylaxis during GI endoscopy is to reduce the

risk of iatrogenic infectious complications.

# Cystic lesions along GI tract including mediastinum:

Antibiotic prophylaxis is recommended before a FNA for cystic lesions along

the GI tract to prevent cyst infection.

# Recommendation:

# INPATIENT:

[Levofloxacin 500 mg PO q24h for 4 days, beginning 60 minutes before](psjzid-levofloxacin-500mg-po-qday-4days-procedure)

endoscopic procedure ($) [R,DI]

# OUTPATIENT:

[Levofloxacin 500 mg PO q24h for 4 days, beginning 60 minutes before](psozid-levofloxacin-500mg-po-once-then-qday-3days)

endoscopic procedure ($) [R,DI]

# Solid Lesions along the upper or lower GI tract:

Antibiotic prophylaxis is not recommended before a diagnostic EUS or EUS-FNA

of solid lesions along the upper or lower GI tract.

# References:

Up-to-Date website

Endoscopy 2008, 67:791-795
